scope.scopeLabel: Two synthetic regional TLS deployments and five planned source families
scope.denominatorBoundary: Exactly two TLS deployment units independently enumerated by denominator:synthetic:authorized-tls-deployments; no enterprise-wide population is represented.

sourceReadiness.qualification: All five synthetic contract packs passed local schema, pagination, reference, and safety validation; this is not live source readiness.

authorizedEstateCoverage.qualification: Both of the two synthetic TLS deployment units in this deliberately bounded denominator have admitted observations; no broader coverage claim is permitted.

evidenceFreshness.qualification: All ten deterministic observations are within the one-hour fixture threshold at the synthetic as-of time; freshness does not establish accuracy.

correlationConfidence.qualification: Confidence describes the deterministic correlation basis of eight synthetic dependencies, not a probability of truth or source accuracy.

evidenceLimitations.qualification: The open limitation is retained visibly and is not converted into a success percentage.

projectionLag.qualification: The projection was built 90 seconds after the latest synthetic authoritative commit it represents; this is separate from observation freshness.
